summary: First iteration full-stack testing of SigmaLab QC. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed covering /api/analytes (49 analytes), /api/records seeded count (40), POST create with correct sigma/qgi computation (TEa 6.96/CV 1.4/Bias 1.1 => sigma=4.19, qgi=0.52), PUT update recomputes, DELETE 404 and success, and instrument filter. Frontend: Calculator live updates confirmed (4.19σ, 'Good · 4.0–4.9σ', QGI 0.52, Westgard 1_3s/2_2s/R_4s/4_1s). DB tab search + Use button prefills TEa 6.96. Method Decision Chart SVG renders. Records tab: 41 rows, edit dialog opens, delete via AlertDialog works and toast 'Record deleted' shown, trend chart renders. Reports tab: KPIs (11 methods, 41 records, distribution) and CSV export downloads file 'sigmalab-qc-report-2026-09-10.csv'. Save from Calculator increments header count 40 -> 41.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager.
SEED_RECORDS list comprehension `[(r[0]..r[6]) for r in SEED_RECORDS]` is redundant — can iterate directly over SEED_RECORDS tuples.
compute_metrics returns 0.0 when cv<=0 silently; consider raising 400 on invalid CV in create/update endpoints.
No pagination on /api/records (hard-coded to_list(2000)); acceptable for MVP but should be paginated for scale.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeded 40 lab records automatically; test created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints under /api verified. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly. Delete uses Radix AlertDialog (not window.confirm) — click the visible 'Delete' button inside role='alertdialog' to confirm. Instrument on Calculator is a Radix Select (not text input) preselected to Roche Cobas c502. Header displays '{n} records tracked' — parse via regex for count assertions.
